schema_note: Classification taxonomy. Cost tiers and SWaP tiers are assigned automatically from equipment figures; do not hand-set them in equipment.json.

cost_tiers.name: Consumable
cost_tiers.posture: Fire without hesitation. Cost is below the decision threshold of an operator under fire.
cost_tiers.acquisition_note: Buy in thousands. Treat as ammunition, not equipment. No depot repair concept.

cost_tiers.name: Attritable
cost_tiers.posture: Expendable against any Group 1-3 threat. Favorable exchange against Shahed-class OWA.
cost_tiers.acquisition_note: Buy in hundreds to thousands. Field-replaceable, no component-level repair.

cost_tiers.name: Expendable
cost_tiers.posture: Expend against Group 2-3 and high-value Group 1. Marginal against cheap FPV.
cost_tiers.acquisition_note: Buy in tens to hundreds. Limited field repair, some recoverable variants.

cost_tiers.name: Reusable Tactical
cost_tiers.posture: Recover and re-arm. Expending one is a resourcing decision, not a reflex.
cost_tiers.acquisition_note: Buy in units to tens. Requires sustainment tail and trained maintainers.

cost_tiers.name: Exquisite / Program of Record
cost_tiers.posture: Protect the system itself. Unfavorable exchange against mass low-cost threats.
cost_tiers.acquisition_note: Program of record acquisition timeline. Depot sustainment, formal training pipeline.

swap_tiers.name: Pocket / Cargo-Pocket
swap_tiers.emplacement: Carried on the person. No emplacement time.
swap_tiers.logistics_note: One operator carries multiple units. No lift requirement.

swap_tiers.name: Man-Packable
swap_tiers.emplacement: Single-soldier carry and setup under 5 minutes.
swap_tiers.logistics_note: Fits a rucksack or single transit case. Airborne and dismounted compatible.

swap_tiers.name: Two-Person Lift
swap_tiers.logistics_note: Two transit cases. Compatible with light tactical vehicles and CH-47 internal.

swap_tiers.name: Vehicle-Mounted
swap_tiers.emplacement: Vehicle integration required. Displaces cargo or crew capacity.
swap_tiers.logistics_note: Requires a dedicated platform and vehicle prime power.

swap_tiers.name: Trailer / Fixed Site
swap_tiers.emplacement: Trailer tow or fixed emplacement. Hours to days to site.
swap_tiers.logistics_note: Generator or grid power. Not survivable in a maneuver posture.

evidence_grades.meaning: Confirmed operational kills or employment in active conflict.
Delivered to operational units, no confirmed combat employment.
Announced and under active development. Performance claims unverified.
Marketing claims only. No independent verification.

postures.name: Attritable First (default)
postures.intent: Maximize favorable cost exchange and magazine depth. Penalize exquisite systems.

postures.name: Balanced
postures.intent: Weigh cost exchange against mission performance and maturity evenly.

postures.name: Capability First
postures.intent: Prioritize mission performance and proven maturity. Accept unfavorable exchange.
